deep_review.conclusion: Repository code is MIT, but that does not establish terms or integrity for separately downloaded model artifacts or referenced training datasets. The model entry is explicitly documentation-scoped; ONNX's download factory is not revision-pinned in source, and TensorRT deserializes a supplied engine, so deployment requires trusted pinned artifacts. YAML uses safe_load, but configured class names and callbacks are resolved through pydoc.locate and instantiated; accept only trusted configurations and installed code. Trace storage and debug output can retain raw inputs, iris templates and intermediate biometric data; isolate processing and control logging/storage/retention. Matching produces distance measurements rather than an authorization decision or proven population-wide uniqueness service. Sensitive surfaces are documented for catalog use; no biometric data was processed, external weights fetched or source code executed.
